properties.name: items
properties.description: This option makes radio component under itself.

properties.name: v-model
properties.description: Binding data with v-model (value of selected item)

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: 'ur-radio-wrapper' Set the 'ur-radio' underneath to the disabled state.

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size you must enter one of two types: small or medium.

properties.name: group
properties.description: When used with ur-radio-wrapper, you can separate it by specifying the group name if you want to apply validate only to a specific radio button rather than to all the radio buttons located under the wrapper.

properties.name: messageStyle
properties.description: Guide, Success, Announcement appearance attributes. You can specify the 'heavy' and 'light' attributes.

properties.name: guideMessage
properties.description: The string to display as the guide message.

properties.name: successMessage
properties.description: The message that is output if validate passes. If there is no setting, guide message or no message is printed. ur-dropdown does not occupy space for message output. Depending on the messageStyle prop, you can apply two style: light and heavy. If you want to print the message, you need to make space.

properties.name: rules
properties.description: Rule-set for using validator. Specified by an Array type, each element returns a boolean true on successful validation and a validate failure error message.

properties.name: lazy
properties.description: Components that use ur-validator-mixin call validateOnEvent() based on component properties. If lazy is set to true, validate() will not execute when validateOnEvent() is called.

properties.name: noShake
properties.description: Determines whether shake animation should be applied to the component when it fails.

events.name: click
events.description: This event is occured when clicked.
